docs.s: The police inquiry where it all began: BRB's purchase of loan portfolios from Banco Master.
What Banco Master did with the money it raised: funds, a sole unitholder and illiquid assets.
The constitutional complaint that moved the whole case from the federal court in Brasília to the Supreme Court.
The first request to lift banking and tax secrecy, based on the contents of the phones.
The investigation into two heads of banking supervision at the Central Bank.
The 48-page ruling that ordered the arrests of the third phase.
The 159-page filing that asked for the searches of March 2026.
The asset freeze that reached R$ 22.4 billion at two companies.
The order for Apple, Google and Microsoft to hand over the account contents of seventeen people under investigation.
The search and seizure against thirteen people, including a Federal Police chief.
The interception of the calls and messages of ten people under investigation, for fifteen days.
Seven pre-trial detentions, five sets of precautionary measures and one police chief removed from duty.
An asset freeze on seven people under investigation, capped at R$ 1.8 million and R$ 9.6 million.
The case born from a single order that ended in an extraordinary session of the full Supreme Court.
The police inquiry into the hiring of influencers to attack the Central Bank.
